spec.title: Simple Web-Based Calculator
spec.summary: A lightweight, pure-HTML/CSS/JavaScript calculator that performs basic arithmetic operations, handles errors, and provides a clean user interface.

files.name: index.html
files.purpose: Provides the complete calculator UI structure, including input fields for operands, a dropdown for operation selection, a result display area, and control buttons, while linking external CSS and JavaScript resources.

files.name: style.css
files.purpose: Defines the visual layout, colors, spacing, and button styling for the calculator interface to ensure a consistent and accessible user experience across browsers.

files.name: app.js
files.purpose: Implements real-time calculation logic, reads and validates user input, executes selected arithmetic operations, handles division by zero and other errors, updates the result display, and resets form values on clear.

acceptance_criteria: Adding two numbers displays the correct sum in the result area.
Subtracting two numbers displays the correct difference in the result area.
Multiplying two numbers displays the correct product in the result area.
Dividing by a non-zero number displays the correct quotient; dividing by zero shows an error message.
The clear button empties all input fields and the result display without errors.
